_comment: Flat seed pile for the deck stage.  There is no filename -> seed mapping:
each of the 305 .ydc decks in deck.pac draws an entry from this pile at
random, deterministically from the master seed, so the pile can be extended
Every entry needs 'seed' (one or more seed cards, exactly as deckgen's
--seed takes them).  All other keys are optional and mirror the deckgen CLI:
allowed_types       list of races to allow    (default: no filter)
allowed_attributes  list of attributes        (default: no filter)
Card names must match the pool's vocabulary; a typo fails that one deck and
leaves it at stock contents rather than aborting the run.
The two entries below are examples taken from the deckgen CLI docstring.
Replace them with the real pile; while the pile is empty or deckgen is not
importable, the deck stage skips and reports why.
